description: Triangle-free non-bipartite: 5 equal parts of size b with edge density p between cyclically adjacent pairs; remaining mass 1−5b is an independent set. The Andrásfai–Erdős–Sós extremal at b=1/5, p=1 (d=2/5).
provenance: C_5(b,p); b=1/5,p=1 is the AES extremal balanced C_5 blow-up at d=2/5; b=1/5 traces the regular surface at d≤2/5; d≤2/5 throughout
